children: (OTCQX:ECRAF) announces that James Rutherford, an independent Non-Executive Director of the Company, has today been appointed as an independent Non-Executive Director of Ionic Rare Earths Limited. Ionic Rare Earths Limited is listed on the Australian Stock Exchange.
This notification satisfies the Company's obligations under UK Listing Rule 6.4.9(2).
